name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Experimental surface tram terminus. Native reversal is not yet proven; test saves only.
description: Private recovery build revision 7. Withdraws revision 6 (0.2.2), which crashes TF3 with Duplicate edges found. Restores the exact crossover construction script from revision 5 (0.2.1), which was placed successfully in-game. Placement fixes remain; the line connection and native reversal are still unresolved. Replace all mod files before restarting, then load a normal save from before the crash. Avoid the crash save, which may include the invalid construction. No automatic save repair or world commands. Internal rails and catenary visuals remain unfinished. Do not publish.
